archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-07.1 Define Governance Frameworks and Policies
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
The process begins with defining the governance structure that guides how data and statistics are managed. This includes creating policies for data governance, metadata management, information security, and quality assurance.
The organization establishes roles and responsibilities — such as data owner, data steward, and quality coordinator — and defines how they interact. Governance committees or boards may be created to oversee compliance and resolve policy issues.
These frameworks form the foundation for consistent decision-making and control across the statistical value chain.
Value created: A clear governance framework that defines ownership, accountability, and rules for data and statistical operations.
